system.description:
Chronicler

History is made every day, but not all people care to remember it. It is your duty as a chronicler to make sure that that history is recorded for future generations. You are one of the few who stand against ignorance. You may be a person obsessed with detail, or maybe a curious scholar looking for all the parts of a story you are invested in writing down. Whatever the reason you have decided to set out into the world to seek out and record all you can find.?

Skill Proficiencies: History, Survival

Tool Proficiencies: Hackers Kit or Forensics Kit

Equipment: A set of Commoners clothes, A wooden case containing a map to a ruin or dungeon.

Equipment Pack: Explorers Pack or Infiltrator’s Pack (Choose one).

Feature: Historical Knowledge

When you enter a ruin, historical site, or location of cultural significance you can identify its original purpose, its builders, and its approximate age without making a check. When you have access to a library, archive, or historical record, research on any topic takes you half the normal downtime. You also gain advantage on History checks related to events that occurred more than 50 years ago..

Know Your Past

Gain a General or Skill feat from Chapter 13 (Recommended: Any Intelligence based Skill Feat)
